Title: Q. Stealing Blood, is it damage

Messages.Author: Andy Berlett
Messages.Body:
If an effect steals blood is that damage?

Can damage prevention cards be played to prevent it?

If a vamp with Memories of Mortality plays a steal blood effect on an Ally
is that reduced to zero or is it stolen?

Can you steal more blood than a minion has to steal? If so, why?

Thanks
Andy

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <andyb-05109...@aa44.arch.vt.edu>,

Andy Berlett <an...@vt.edu> wrote:
>If an effect steals blood is that damage?

No.

>Can damage prevention cards be played to prevent it?

No.

>If a vamp with Memories of Mortality plays a steal blood effect on an Ally
>is that reduced to zero or is it stolen?

Interesting. It can, but it does get around the card's intent.

>Can you steal more blood than a minion has to steal? If so, why?

No. It wasn't there to take in the first place.

gomi
